UI_PSF_Options_DodgeAnimation_tooltip: Players dodging with a photon sword leap away with it held in the sword hand. Off: they play Martial Arts Core's Pak Mei dodge, which lets the sword drift from the hand. Applies to every player you see.
UI_PSF_Options_RelightAfterDodge_tooltip: When a dodge put your blade out (the server's Extinguish While Dodging option), relight it as you land, if the battery holds charge.
UI_PSF_ChoiceTip: You know more than one Form. Click to choose which one you fight with.
UI_PSF_ChoiceHint: Choose this Form with the button below to fight with it.
UI_PSF_form1_EquipStaff: Ignite a photon sword and hold it in both hands.
UI_PSF_form1_GuideEquipment: Ignite a photon sword and hold it in both hands. If you know more than one Form, choose which one you fight with in the Photon Sword tab.
UI_PSF_form1_GuideTraining: The foundation Form. Successful hits train Martial Arts and Form 1 mastery. Mastery unlocks seventeen attacks, which shuffle without repeats. Hold the Martial Arts Block key while aiming to guard: blocks drain the guard meter, a block just as you raise it staggers the attacker, and an empty meter breaks your guard. Release aim to cancel.
